en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden street-front of early 20th‑century shops in a Nordic town. Two-storey timber buildings with large display windows line a cobbled or dirt street. Several people in period clothing (long skirts, waistcoats, bowler hats) stand outside. Visible shop signs read 'Iwar Lindstrand. Manufaktur‑klädes & herrekiperingsaffär' above a clothing store and 'C. E. Ramm. Bok- & pappershandel' above a bookstore/stationer. Books and printed items are displayed in the right-hand window.
